entry.title: How to customise your Di2 shiftings? | Shimano Tips & Tricks | Episode 4

media:group.media:title: How to customise your Di2 shiftings? | Shimano Tips & Tricks | Episode 4
media:group.media:description:
Want your Di2 to shift exactly the way you like? Electronic shifting isn't just smoother, it's fully customisable. The Shimano E-TUBE PROJECT Cyclist app lets you update your groupset, check your battery, reassign your buttons and personalise how your bike shifts.
In this fourth episode of Shimano Tips & Tricks, UCI World Cycling Centre mechanic Benny, joined by WCC rider Florencia, shows you how to set up the E-TUBE PROJECT Cyclist app and tailor your Di2 to the way you ride.
Whether you're an everyday rider or just getting started with electronic shifting, Benny walks you through everything you need to connect, configure and customise your Di2 in a few minutes.
WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
- How to connect your bike: download the E-TUBE PROJECT Cyclist app and pair your Di2 via Bluetooth. It works with all Bluetooth-equipped 11- and 12-speed Di2 groupsets - How to keep your Di2 healthy: run firmware updates and check your battery level from the app's maintenance panel - How to configure your cycling computer: pair your Di2, set up your data pages and flick through them with your D-Fly buttons - How to customise your shifting: reassign your switches and set up synchronised shifting for automatic gear changes
CHAPTERS 0:52 Step 1: connect your bike 2:31 Step 2: configure your computer 3:43 Step 3: customise your buttons 4:56 Step 4: synchronised shifting 5:36 When to see a professional
Need deeper maintenance? Find your nearest Shimano Service Center: 👉 https://bike.shimano.com/support-and-service/shimano-service-center.html
▶ Watch the full Shimano Tips & Tricks playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLSPNTZtSDUF0
Next up: how to set up and install your cleats correctly on your shoes (Episode 5).

entry.title: Ride Your Colours | The story behind the jerseys | @SantiniCycling

media:group.media:title: Ride Your Colours | The story behind the jerseys | @SantiniCycling
media:group.media:description:
Through its Solidarity Programme, the UCI and its Partner Santini worked with 41 National Federations to create cycling kits designed around their own colours, symbols and cultural identity.
This is the story of Ride Your Colours: from the first sketches and the final stitch of the jerseys in Santini’s Bergamo workshop to the 2026 UCI Road World Championships in Montréal and what it meant for riders and Federations who wore them.
The UCI Solidarity Programme was launched in 2018 to support the development of cycling worldwide, in collaboration with the Continental Confederations and National Federations.
🗳️ Which design is your favourite? Vote here 👉 https://story.tl/ride-your-colours 🌈 Discover the full project 👉 https://ride-your-colours.uci.org
#RideYourColours
